Bill.BriefDescription: Providing transportation to the lieutenant governor's spouse for activities conducted on behalf of the state.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the lieutenant governor; and amending RCW43.43.035.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.43.035 and 1991 c 63 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The chief of the Washington state patrol is directed to providesecurity and protection for the governor, the governor's family, andthe lieutenant governor, and transportation for the lieutenantgovernor's spouse when conducting official state business inconjunction with the lieutenant governor, to the extent and in themanner the governor and the chief of the Washington state patrol deemadequate and appropriate. In the same manner the chief of the Washington state patrol isdirected to provide security and protection for the governorelect fromthe time of the November election.
